completed_steps.summary: Classified as a monolith with one web application part
Identified Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript / Airtable stack
Documented API surface, Airtable-backed data models, state management, UI components, and missing routes
Captured source tree and critical directories
Recorded development commands, env requirements, and PWA deployment constraints
Wrote architecture documentation for the single app part

findings.project_classification: Single-part Next.js web monolith for public onboarding, attendance capture, staff contact entry, and live dashboard workflows.
findings.technology_stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Airtable REST API, service worker + IndexedDB offline queue.
findings.architecture_summary: Client-heavy App Router UI with thin server integration via /attendance and Airtable-backed data access.
findings.open_risks: UI expects /api/registration and /api/contact but this repository only implements /attendance; auth is client-only; offline behavior is split across multiple mechanisms.

resume_instructions: Workflow complete. Start a fresh scan to regenerate documentation after major code changes.
